curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8217-1-1.pdf (main steps 1-15 in red; the rotor mast is black steps 1-8 on pages 5-7, the tail black steps 1-5 on pages 13-14)

functions.does: Pushed along, the two wheels turn together on one long axle, and a 12-tooth bevel gear on that axle turns another on the bottom of the upright rotor mast, so the main rotor spins as fast as the wheels; turning the rotor by hand turns the wheels too.
functions.source: book: main steps 1, 3 and 8 (the wheels and the bevel gear on their axle), mast steps 7-8, main steps 5 and 15 (the mast and the rotor blades)

functions.does: The tail rotor, a dark 5-hole beam with yellow round plates at its ends, spins freely on its pin at the end of the tail boom.
